text_en: Draw near, O nations, to hear; O peoples, give heed! Let the earth hear, and all that fills it; the world, and all that comes from it.
text_cn: 万民，你们前来聆听！列邦，你们侧耳静听！大地与充塞其中的一切，世界与其所有的产物，都要谛听！

text_en: For the Lord is enraged against all the nations, and furious against all their hordes; he has doomed them, has given them over for slaughter.
text_cn: 因为上主向万民生了气，对他们的一切军队发了怒，他注定了他们的劫数，命定了他们遭受屠杀。

text_en: Their slain shall be cast out, and the stench of their corpses shall rise; the mountains shall flow with their blood.
text_cn: 他们的被杀者被弃于外，他们尸体的腥臭浮浮上腾，他们的血溶化了诸山。

text_en: All the host of heaven shall rot away, and the skies roll up like a scroll. All their host shall wither like a leaf withering on a vine, or fruit withering on a fig tree.
text_cn: 天上的万象必将解体，诸天要如卷轴般卷起；天上的星辰必将陨坠，有如葡萄叶的凋零，有如无花果叶的萎谢。

text_en: When my sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, lo, it will descend upon Edom, upon the people I have doomed to judgment.
text_cn: 当上主的刀在天上痛饮之后，看哪！它将落在厄东，落在他所毁灭的百姓身上，实行惩罚。

text_en: The Lord has a sword; it is sated with blood, it is gorged with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the Lord has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
text_cn: 上主的刀剑染满了血，渍满了脂油，是羔羊和羚羊的血，以及公羊肾脏的脂油：因为上主在波责辣举行了一番祭祀，在厄东地方施行了一场屠杀。

text_en: Wild oxen shall fall with them, and young steers with the mighty bulls. Their land shall be soaked with blood, and their soil made rich with fat.
text_cn: 野牛与肥畜必同堕死，牛犊与公牛必同跌毙。他们的地区浸满了血，他们的地面渍染了脂油。

text_en: For the Lord has a day of vengeance, a year of vindication by Zion’s cause.
text_cn: 因为这是上主复仇的日子，是为报复熙雍敌人的一年。

text_en: And the streams of Edom shall be turned into pitch, and her soil into sulfur; her land shall become burning pitch.
text_cn: 她的河水将变为沥青，她的土壤将变为硫磺：大地成了燃灼的沥青，

text_en: Night and day it shall not be quenched; its smoke shall go up forever. From generation to generation it shall lie waste; no one shall pass through it forever and ever.
text_cn: 昼夜燃烧不息，浓烟永远上升；世世代代成为荒野，永久无人经过此地。

text_en: But the hawk and the hedgehog shall possess it; the owl and the raven shall live in it. He shall stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plummet of chaos over its nobles.
text_cn: 鹈（tí）鹕（hú）和刺猬据守其地，鸮（xiāo）鸱（chī）和乌鸦栖于其间；上主将以破坏性的绳墨和毁灭性的线锤测量那地。

text_en: They shall name it No Kingdom There, and all its princes shall be nothing.
text_cn: 显贵中没有一个在那里能够建国，她所有王侯都归于乌有。

text_en: Thorns shall grow over its strongholds, nettles and thistles in its fortresses. It shall be the haunt of jackals, an abode for ostriches.
text_cn: 她的宫阙将生满荆棘，她的堡垒将繁生蒺(jí)藜(lí)和蓟(jì)草；她将成为豺狼的洞穴，鸵鸟的苑(yuàn)囿(yòu)。

text_en: Wildcats shall meet with hyenas, goat-demons shall call to each other; there too Lilith shall repose, and find a place to rest.
text_cn: 野猫在那里将与野狗相会，野羊将呼叫它的同类；夜间的魑魅（chī mèi）将在那里休憩，寻得一个安息的处所。

text_en: There shall the owl nest and lay and hatch and brood in its shadow; there too the buzzards shall gather, each one with its mate.
text_cn: 箭头蛇将在那里筑穴、下蛋、伏卵，并加以孵化；鸷（zhì）鸟群集其间，雌雄相配。

text_en: Seek and read from the book of the Lord : Not one of these shall be missing; none shall be without its mate. For the mouth of the Lord has commanded, and his spirit has gathered them.
text_cn: 你们可查看上主的书，且阅读一下，它们中一种也不会缺少，没有一个没有配偶的，因为上主的口已这样命定，他的神集合了它们。

text_en: He has cast the lot for them, his hand has portioned it out to them with the line; they shall possess it forever, from generation to generation they shall live in it.
text_cn: 上主亲自要为它们抽签，他亲手用绳索将为它们分开这地；它们将永久占有这地，世世代代住在那里。
